text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out on a walk, I heard a familiar 
voice and went down beneath the elevated 
bridge...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"We recommend official penlights! 
Commercial lights might be too large or 
overly bright!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And swinging your penlights around 
excessively is a no-go! Excess hype can 
sometimes become a deadly weapon...!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Students
text_block_list.text: I see, as expected of Master!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san! These folks asked me to 
teach them how to enjoy the Winning Live!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text:
We only just became Umamusume fans 
recently, so we don't know anything at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text:
I heard rumors that Digital-san's 
knowledge and experience are god-tier, so 
I asked her to take me on as her 
apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, let's resume our 
training! Everyone, visualize the venue 
and..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Feel the sense of unity in the concert! 
It's not just about yourself... it's about 
the fans, your idols... It's the sensation 
of everyone getting hyped together!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! When waving the penlight, 
coordinate with everyone around you to 
create a giant wave!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, it's vital to listen 
intently when the moment calls for it! I 
highly recommend studying the concert 
footage beforehand!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: P-Preparation... *gulp*...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Moving on to the next one! Up next is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew~ That about covers the basics. 
Um... are you two all right?"

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Master really is incredible after 
all. It feels like he's dedicating his 
whole life to it...

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text:
"In comparison, we're complete newcomers 
who don't understand a thing..."

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I definitely don't have the 
right to go to the live concert...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Qualifications, you say...? I don't have 
anything like that either, you know?

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: N-No way! Even at Master's level...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! In the first place, you don't 
need any qualifications!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I just want to create a stage overflowing 
with love, together with my fave and all 
the other fans!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I simply... whole-heartedly love 
Umamusume, love my favorites!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What you need to support your 
Umamusume-chan isn't qualifications, but 
love—and nothing else...!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: Master... Can we possess love, too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"No, the two of you are already 
overflowing with love for Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Plucking up the courage to speak to me. 
Carrying such burning passion for the 
concert. ...It is all love.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To have you all cheering on the Umamusume 
together with me... is just the best!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much, Master!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text:
We will never forget our love for the 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Kufufu... Looks like both of you have 
fallen shoulder-deep into the Umamusume 
rabbit hole~♪
choice_data_list:
Does this mean your disciple has 
graduated?

Let's enjoy this together as comrades from 
now on!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's nothing more to teach... No, 
those two should have been fine from the 
very beginning!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all! Thanks to you, 
Master, we were able to gain confidence!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text:
"The next time we meet will surely be at 
the live concert venue! Um…… I'm really 
looking forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'll deepen my love for the 
Umamusume even further too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's both enjoy our otaku lives! 
...Hehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After interacting with the kids, Agnes 
Digital showed a different kind of smile 
than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's one more thing to look forward 
to at the concert♪

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text:
About that, um... I... want to switch my 
oshi to Digital-san!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm switching my bias too! Your genuine, 
passionate feelings for the Umamusume are 
just too wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wha, huh, m-m-me!? There are way cuter 
Umamusume around, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text:
I totally love that humble side of you 
too~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm happy to hear that, but still! 
Wait, but!? What am I supposed to do~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital continued to writhe in agony 
and ecstasy beneath their passionate 
gazes...!
